dedupe_keys.name: u s national liquefaction hazard maps

description: U.S. National Liquefaction Hazard Maps is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Morgan Sanger, University of Washington (washington.edu). This dataset contains a suite of raster files (geotiffs) and map products which comprise U.S. National Liquefaction Hazard Maps (NLHMs). These products are developed using the geospatial liquefaction model (GLM) of Sanger et al. (2025), wherein liquefaction hazard is mapped across the contiguous U.S. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project with 7 top-level files (PDF). Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-05v8-d571. Keywords: U.S. National Liquefaction Hazard Maps, geospatial liquefaction model, ground failure, liquefaction hazard. Published 2026-06-30. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
